question: Does the original full-invariant-cylinder generator defect tend to zero in original fine-Gibbs L2 at all tail pairs, for every fixed admitted tuple and base observable?
statement: At the fixed epsilon=1, h=N=0, r0=2 tuple, the single gauge/anchor-invariant f0=exp(2*pi*i*Phi/5) has ||Delta_(r,r+1)f_r||_(L2(pi_(r+1)))>=7 at adjacent pairs beyond every cutoff threshold. The lower bound holds at every full fine state and hence under its original normalized Gibbs state. This disproves GD-002 without changing model, time, comparison or observable domain.

exact_scope.dimension: Two-dimensional combinatorial addresses only; no physical dimension.
exact_scope.carrier: Existing h=N=0 anchored open side-two square, 4 vertices, 4 stored edges, 1 face. O=(0,0), C=(1,0) are labels.
exact_scope.model: Immutable PAH-001-v2-r2 with the displayed PAH-v1 functional, signed roots and original rates.
exact_scope.normalization: Original full integer-tuple counting Gibbs state; no conditioning or replacement state.
exact_scope.domain: Full invariant finite complex algebras and approved algebraic cylinder pullbacks. No limiting-generator domain declared.
exact_scope.limits: Arbitrary local-state-cutoff tail thresholds at fixed h=N=0; later lattice then volume then inherited stages unexecuted.
exact_scope.time: Unchanged external stochastic Markov time, stationary initial-value boundary.

counterexample.fixed_base: r0=2, K_2=30; f0=exp(2*pi*i*Phi/5); Phi is the unique signed plaquette link sum.
counterexample.root_audit: Every PH/TR/AP increment is individually zero; eight valid signed LK incidences remain with their original exponential rates.
counterexample.uniform_rate_bound: For K_r>=8, |Delta F|<=16/K_r, |c-1|<=16/K_r, and |L_r f_r-lambda(a_r)f_r|<=256/K_r on every state.
counterexample.tail_construction: Given R, let m=max(R,4), B=p_(m+1), P=product_(p<=B,p!=5)p, t=P^(-1) mod5 in {1,2,3,4}. Every prime factor of 1+tP exceeds B; at least one q=p_k is 2 or 3 mod5. Choose r=k-2>=m and s=r+1.
counterexample.positive_lower_bound: The CRT step swaps the two eigenvalue classes: gap=4*sqrt(5)>8. Full defect >=8-512/K_r>=7 because K_r>=K_4=2310. Thus original Gibbs norm squared >=49.

separate_diagnostics.nontriviality: At the same fixed tuple, Var_pi(f_r)>=exp(-14/3) and the original Dirichlet energy >=4/exp(1), for r>=r0. Neither constant nor zero-energy collapse explains the defect.
separate_diagnostics.domination_only: Normalized uniform counting gamma_r is used only to prove pi_r>=exp(-14/3)gamma_r from 0<=F_r<=14/3. The target is always weighted by original pi_r.
separate_diagnostics.semigroup: NOT_EVALUATED; generator nonconvergence is not by itself a semigroup no-go.
